verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the pricing page, which lists "83(b) generation" as a plan feature. That covers one of the three compliance items, but only as a single bullet with no detail on how it is generated from the cap table. ASC 718 reporting is a different compliance area and does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: any evidence of Rule 701 disclosure-threshold tracking, Form 3921 filing generation, documentation of how 83(b) elections are generated and tracked from cap table data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
